meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: Claude 会为 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮箱渠道：复制并注册邮件适配器、安装依赖并构建测试；再引导你填写密钥和发件方设置，把指定邮箱设为所有者并发出欢迎邮件。
howto.when: 通常是你要求给 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮件（例如想用邮箱跟机器人对话），或在 /setup 流程里走到邮件这一步时被使用。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Resend 邮件频道。
say.note: 开始复制并注册邮件适配器。

say.text: 帮我接上 Resend，我想用邮箱和机器人聊天。
say.note: 需要你提供 Resend 密钥和邮箱信息。

say.text: 把我的邮箱设为所有者并接上 Resend 邮件。
say.note: 配置完成后会向该邮箱发欢迎信。

howto.what_en: Adds Resend email as a NanoClaw channel: copies and registers the adapter, installs a pinned dependency, runs build/tests. Then prompts for credentials, sets your email as owner, and sends a welcome email.
howto.when_en: Typically used when you ask to add Resend email to NanoClaw (e.g. to talk with the bot by email), or when a /setup flow reaches its email step.

say_en.text: Add Resend email as a channel for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Starts copying and registering the adapter.

say_en.text: Set up Resend so I can chat with the bot by email.
say_en.note: Asks for your Resend key and mailbox.

say_en.text: Make my email the owner and wire up Resend.
say_en.note: Sends a welcome email once configured.
